reachability.notes: Site loads successfully. Next.js app on Vercel with SSR/RSC streaming.

1.2_markdown_negotiation.details: Accept: text/markdown returns text/html; charset=utf-8. No markdown content negotiation.

1.3_structured_metadata.details: No meta description, no og:description, no JSON-LD found. Only viewport/theme-color/referrer meta tags present.

2.1_content_without_js.details: Next.js SSR streams real text content in HTML via RSC payload. i18n strings and page content are present in initial HTML, not an empty div#root.

2.2_semantic_html.details: Only nav and footer confirmed in rendered output. Most structure is React components without semantic HTML elements. Does not meet 3+ threshold.

2.3_readable_url_slugs.details: URLs are human-readable: /en/markets, /en/tyd, /en/vote, /en/portfolio, /en/attesters. Market pages use contract addresses which is acceptable for web3.

2.4_sitemap_xml.details: Valid sitemap.xml with 31 URLs, proper XML structure, hreflang for en/zh, lastmod dates, priorities, and change frequencies. Referenced in robots.txt.

2.5_proper_404s.details: /this-does-not-exist-xyz123 redirects 307 to /en/this-does-not-exist-xyz123 which returns proper HTTP 404 status.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.details: docs.trueo.com exists with protocol documentation covering trading, tokenomics, oracle mechanics, governance, and market resolution. Linked from main site.

3.2_docs_findable.details: Docs link (docs.trueo.com) visible in main site footer navigation. One click from homepage.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.details: No API docs, SDK references, contract ABIs, or developer integration guides found on docs.trueo.com. Documentation is protocol-concept focused only. GitHub link exists but no programmatic docs.

3.4_standard_navigation.details: Standard anchor (a href) links used for navigation including footer links to /terms, /privacy, docs.trueo.com, GitHub, Discord, and internal routes.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.details: robots.txt allows all user-agents (User-Agent: * / Allow: /). Only /debug/ disallowed. No AI crawlers blocked. Sitemap referenced.

4.2_no_captcha.details: No CAPTCHA or bot-blocking mechanisms detected. Uses wallet-based authentication only.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.details: No bot policy, AI agent documentation, or machine-readable API guidance found.

strengths: Proper SSR with real content in initial HTML (Next.js RSC streaming)
Valid sitemap.xml with 31 URLs and hreflang support
weaknesses: No meta description or structured data (JSON-LD, OpenGraph)
No API/SDK/developer documentation despite being a web3 protocol
No bot policy or agent-specific guidance
